docs.text:
Fleming’s catalogue of the medicinal plants and drugs of India with their Sanskrit and Hindustani names and the uses ascribed to them by the Hindu physicians (Calcutta, 1810). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Francis A. Countway Library of Medicine; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: A catalogue of Indian medicinal plants and drugs : with their names in the Hindustani and Sanscrit languages · Fleming, John, d. 1815 · 1810, 92 scanned pages. Published 1810; John Fleming died 1815; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
